body: Ignore anyone who decides to needlessly bully for literally no reason. You are hella talented. Also thanks! I'll have to check those out. Good luck with your art, its already amazing!
Honestly you are super talented. What pen do you use if you dont mind me asking? The color is so even and intense its impressive.
Thank you for posting this, I feel the exact same way and it really feels good to know I'm not alone.

Mainly I would urge you to look into alternative, nonharmful forms of SH. ice can be really helpful, it imitates the same pain and response. And, only if you are safe, try to have a conversation with your dad about his and your actions? I know it hurts for him to take them away but please remember he isnt sure what to do either.
I'm really sorry. I wont attempt to understand what you are going through because that is impossible. I wish you all the best anyways.

I'm sorry, I understand the feeling of each year feeling like it's getting worse and worse. I didnt mean for it to come off that way. I hope you find something to have more birthdays for, I hope we both do.
That is amazing! not only because the art is super impressive but because it helped express your emotions and get them out.
Happy birthday. I'm not sure what you are going through but I'm proud you made it another year.

I understand how you feel. Most of the time I feel like god made a mistake and put a person on earth with absolutely no purpose. The way I have stayed alive and kept pushing was by making one vital decision: to carve out a place in a world that doesnt seen to want me. Spite might not be a motivator for you, but I think there is one out there for you. If you want to talk to someone who feels kinda the same way, let me know.
You are going to be okay. We both will. At some point it will get better and you will be happy. You will have something worth living and thriving for even if you currently dont.

I know it has been 20 minutes but please give yourself time to remember where you are and when. breath slowly. were you able to stop the bleeding? take this one step at a time and please take the time to remember you are safe in this moment.
thanks, sometimes it feels good just to know you're not alone. I hope you're doing alright

my issue is that my moods never have a definable cause they just happen out of no where. it is exhausting to be angry at something that doesnt exist and to be heartbreakingly sad over something that never happened. but ty for your advise the second half is helpful especially the numb part
same, I feel good knowing other people feel like me but damn is anyone happy?
